title: Network access: usable from anywhere
summary: A test machine must be usable from anywhere so QA runs from any controller, including cloud sessions and other networks. SSH is open to every source address with key-only authentication: password and keyboard-interactive SSH disabled, the project's shared test-machine key authorized, and a dedicated non-admin test account. The desktop goes through the SSH forward (desktop_route=ssh-forward); no public RDP or VNC port is opened and SSH is not limited by source address. The rule lives once in the host-provisioning index under Network access and each OS guide links to it.
